AGENDA
  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MEETING
  Council Chambers, City Hall – 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206

Welcome to the meeting of the Civil Service Commission. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast throughout the
week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs and Videotapes of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office by
  calling (818) 548-2090. Please turn off cellular phones and pagers while inside the Council Chambers.

 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are
available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required
  for requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services.

All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will
  be available for review in the Human Resources office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 100, Glendale, CA 91206.

  If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact Human Resources at (818) 548-2110 during

  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  MINUTES
  MayS, 2019
  City Council Chambers

1.  ROLL CALL
  Vice Chair Ghazarian called the meeting to order at 5:09 pm.

  Present: Manoukian, Devine, Abkarian, Vice Chair Ghazarian.
  Absent: Chair MacCarley.

2.  MINUTES
  Action: Consideration of the Minutes for the meeting of April 10, 2019.

  Motion: Manoukian  Second: Abkarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Chair MacCarley

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items NOT a part of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to five minutes. Commission
  may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.
  None
4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Recruitment and Examination Report.

5.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Eligible Lists Established.

6.  CLASS SPECIFICATION AND JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL- HUMAN RESOURCES ADMINISTRATOR
  (MARTIN)
  Action: Approval of class specification and job bulletin for Human Resources Administrator as submitted.

  The class specification and job bulletin for Human Resources Administrator were approved as submitted by
  the following vote:

  Motion: Manoukian  Second: Abkarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Chair MacCarley

7.  JOB BULLETINS FOR APPROVAL-ENERGY MARKETER/TRADER AND POWER SYSTEMS ANALYST
  (VARDANYAN)
  Action: Approval of job bulletins for Energy Marketer/Trader and Power Systems Analyst as submitted.
  The job bulletins for Energy Marketer/Trader and Power Systems Analyst were approved as submitted by the
  following vote:

  Motion: Manoukian  Second: Devine
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Chair MacCarley

8.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL-POLICE LIEUTENANT (CHAVEZ)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Police lieutenant as submitted.
  The job bulletin for Police lieutenant was approved as submitted by the following vote:
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of May 8, 2019
  Page 2 of 2

  Motion: Manoukian  Second: Devine
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Chair MacCarley

9.  REPORTS- INFORMATION
  a)  Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations.

  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations Report.

10.  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  Commissioner Devine inquired about the internal promotability panel language in the Civil Service Rules. Mr.
  Doyle described how the promotability panels are used for safety positions. Commissioner Device asked Mr.
  Doyle to compile a follow-up report regarding the concerns that Mr. Alvarez presented during a prior Civil
  Service Commission Meeting that would help the Commission understand how oral board panels are
  compiled, display the pros and cons of using internal panelists/raters in promotional examinations, address
  the impact that a rater recusal process may have on the rest of the panel members, and discuss how the use
  of an internal panel may sacrifice the objectivity of the panel and possibly create a potential conflict.
  Commissioner Abkarian would also like staff to provide an example of how the panel members score the
  candidates they interview. Commissioners Manoukian and Ghazarian concurred with their fellow
  Commissioners. Mr. Doyle stated that he will present a report addressing the concerns presented by the
  Commissioners and noted that a typical process involves an outside panel formulating an eligible hiring list
  based on the oral panel interviews.

11.  CLOSED SESSION
  a) Public Employee Discipline: Police Officer

12.  ADJOURNMENT
  Action: Move to adjourn.
  There being no further business to come before the Commission, the meeting was adjourned at 5:49 pm.

  We, the members of the Civil Service Commission of the City of Glendale, certify that the foregoing Minutes

  are ~ tr~ ~yS,2019.

  Mark MacCarley, Chair
